In a non-religious group, accountability might be more informal, relying on mutual respect and trust. However, this can still be effective if the group is committed to helping each other grow. A non-religious group can also foster this sense of belonging if the members feel connected and supported by each other. I should also consider potential challenges. However, if the group is intentional about their shared values and communicates openly, they can overcome these challenges.
